abilities.name: Framing: Freezing Point Composition

variants.label: Focused Impression (Hold)
_curatorNotes: Hold cast (Focused Impression). input:['hE'] added 2026-07-15 — was previously the unreachable input-less 'Finisher Frame Cast' (cooldown only, no frames). gcsim skillHoldCD=1080f=18s (base Press = 720f = 12s). Frames = skillHoldFrames at min hold (hold=1): swap=134+1, N=132+1, E/Q=130+1; the hold parameter adds a variable offset, D/J stay at the InitAbilSlice 137 default (omitted per recipe). Hold cooldownStartDelay is parametric (hitmark-2) — AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field (see [[curator-notes-deferral-survey]]).
behavior changed from generator-stub 'stance' to 'instant'. Charlotte's Composition Mode (Hold) is a caster aiming state — normals/charge are NOT replaced. Not a stance per recipe table.
generator-stub 'duration: 15' removed. That value was the Composition Mode max hold time (not an entity lifetime); no summons[] authored for the marks (see below).
Press frames authored as base 'frames'. Press cooldownStartDelay = 29f (skillPressDelay from gcsim).

Hold variant has variable frame duration: gcsim total animation = hold + skillHoldFrames[next], where hold is a runtime parameter (range 1–809f, min hitmark = hold+111). Post-release cancel frames (min hold=1): swap=134+1=135, N=132+1=133, Q=130+1=131, E=130+1=131; D and J default to AnimationLength (137+1=138) — not real cancels. Hold cooldownStartDelay is also variable: hitmark-2 = (hold+111)-2 = hold+109 (minimum ~110f).

Snappy Silhouette and Focused Impression marks are enemy-targeted periodic DMG sources (AttackTagElementalArt, ICDTagCharlotteMark / ICDGroupCharlotteMark), ticking every 90f (1.5s). Not spawned entities — not modeled as summons[]. Reviewer to decide representation. Press mark: 360+48=408f (~6.8s); Hold mark: 720+54=774f (~12.9s).

'heal' tag removed 2026-07-12: E is damage/marking only — no heal anywhere in gcsim skill.go or kit text. The tag was a mis-tag from the A1 tag batch (heals attached to Charlotte's kit all originate from the burst; even C6's coordinated heal is burst-attributed despite triggering off E's Focused Impression mark).

abilities.name: Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation
_curatorNotes: Heal effects authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10: Cast Healing 461.8% ATK + 3539 (instant, all party members, on cast) + Kamera Continuous Regeneration 16.6% ATK + 126 per tick (active character within the field only). Targets verified against gcsim burst.go: initial heal uses Target: -1 (whole party); dot heal targets c.Core.Player.Active() gated on IsWithinArea(healAP) — hence target: active, not team. Kit text agrees ('all nearby party members' / 'active character(s) within its AoE').

Tick cadence from gcsim burstTickFrames = [95, 119, 143, 166, 179, 203, 226, 249] (cast-relative; field spawns at 53f). Dominant interval 24f = 0.4s with one irregular 13f gap (166→179); authored as interval 0.4 / firstTickDelay 0.7 (95-53 = 42f). Actual tick count is 8; the regularized cadence renders 9 within the 4s window — accepted approximation.
ATK and Healing Bonus snapshot at cast for both the initial heal and all dot ticks (gcsim takes one Snapshot and computes heal/healDot from it before queuing).

Kamera also deals periodic Cryo DMG on the same tick frames (Kamera DMG 11.6% ATK at TL10, ICDTagCharlotteKamera); damage ticks not authored — heal-focused pass. C1 Verification heal-over-time rides on these heal events (see constellation node).

constellations.name: A Need to Verify Facts
constellations.description: After Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation heals a character, it will mark them with Verification, which will heal them once every 2s for 80% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect lasts 6s.
_curatorNotes: ↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C1 A Need to Verify Facts — effects[0] (heal 80% atk) RE-TRIGGERED. gcsim: `charlotte/cons.go:41-56` — `c1()` subscribes to `event.OnHeal`, accepts `healInitialMsg` / `healDotMsg` / `c6HealMsg`, and stamps the **healed character** with a 6s `c1StatusKey`; `cons.go:24-39` then heals that character `0.8 × TotalAtk` every 120f while the status holds. the value is PER TICK — three ticks of 80% ATK over the 6s mark (`cons.go:30-37`, re-queued at `2*60`); the schema has no non-summon tick cadence, so the per-tick figure is authored and the cadence stays here. Also keep that the mark is applied by ANY of the burst's heals (initial `Target:-1`, the field's per-tick active-only heal, and the C6 heal) but the initial cast heal already reaches the whole party and `cons.go:50-51` refuses to re-mark a character who is still marked — so `onCast(burst)` subsumes all three sources rather than dropping two. ⚠️ ⚠️ the authored `target: 'self'` is WRONG and is corrected here — gcsim heals `char.Index()`, the character that was healed, and the burst's initial heal is party-wide. No collision: Charlotte's burst already claims `heal`, so this adds a C1-gated provenance row rather than a new facet.

constellations.name: A Summation of Interest
constellations.description: When the active character's Normal and Charged Attacks hit an opponent marked by Framing: Freezing Point Composition's Focused Impression, Monsieur Verite will initiate a coordinated attack that deals 180% of Charlotte's ATK as AoE Cryo DMG and heals active character(s) within the AoE for 42% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 6s and both DMG and healing dealt in this way will be considered as having been done by Charlotte's Elemental Burst.
_curatorNotes: ↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6 A Summation of Interest — effects[0] (damage 180% atk cryo) RE-TRIGGERED and RE-HOMED onto the skill's hE variant. ⚓ A proc is armed by the CAST that hosts it: `armCastProcs` (`sim/run.ts`) is handed `variant?.effects ?? active.effects` and never sees a constellation entry, so an effect authored here would be armed by nothing. The constellation gate travels with the effect's own `conditions` instead (the Faruzan C6 precedent). gcsim: `charlotte/cons.go:113-160` — `OnEnemyDamage`, gated on `skillHoldMarkKey` (the Focused Impression mark, `skill.go:197` = `720+0.9*60` = 774f), on `ae.Info.ActorIndex == Core.Player.Active()`, and on `AttackTagNormal || AttackTagExtra`; sets a 6s `c6IcdKey`, then at +14f queues a Cryo `AttackTagElementalBurst`, `ICDTagNone`, Durability 25 hit **and** a `0.42 × TotalAtk` heal to the active character. `armedFor: 12` is the kit's "Focused Impression" Mark Duration (genshin-db `combat2` param8 = 12s at every talent level), **not** gcsim's 774f ≈ 12.9s — the two disagree and the kit is taken; the window opens at the cast while the mark in fact lands at the hold's hitmark, which is the stated `armedFor` convention. `icdGate: 'none'` is gcsim's `ICDTagNone` (`cons.go:137`); `units: 1` is its Durability 25; `frame: 14` is `Tasks.Add(…, 14)` with the inner `QueueAttack` at hitmark 0. Keep that the hit is tagged Elemental Burst in game, which is cosmetic here. ⚠️ gcsim runs ONE `c6IcdKey` over both the damage and the heal; authored as two effects they get two independent 6s `procCooldown` clocks. They cannot drift in practice — both fire off the same hit stream with the same filter — but a future change to one filter would desynchronise them. `source: 'active'` correctly includes Charlotte's own swings when she is on field (`cons.go:126`). No stat collision (heal and damage are different effect kinds); adding the heal introduces no new facet, Charlotte already claims `heal` from the burst.
constellations.caveat: The coordinated attack only fires while an opponent still carries the Focused Impression mark from a held Skill; a tapped Skill's Snappy Silhouette does not arm it.
